tasks.title: Run V9 Analysis on Test Repository
tasks.description: Generate a complete V9 analysis output for auditing. Run V9 analysis with complete mode and save raw JSON output.
steps: Check if test-v9-lite-e2e.ts exists in packages/agents/tests/integration/
If not, create a simple V9 test script that runs analysis
Run V9 analysis and capture JSON output
Save to /tmp/v9-raw-output.json

tasks.title: Audit Quality Scores Section
tasks.description: Verify quality score data exists for dashboard. Check for overall score, security score, code quality score, performance score, maintainability score, grade, and trend data.
steps: Read V9 output from /tmp/v9-raw-output.json or examine V9PRAnalyzer output types
Search for score-related fields
Document which fields exist: overall, security, codeQuality, performance, maintainability, grade
Document which fields are MISSING
Note field locations in output structure

tasks.title: Audit Issue Summary Section
tasks.description: Verify issue categorization data exists. Check for total, new, fixed, existingModified, existingRest, bySeverity, byCategory, blocking, autoFixed, manualRequired counts.
steps: Search V9 output for issue count fields
Verify NEW/FIXED/EXISTING categorization exists
Verify severity breakdown (critical, high, medium, low, info) exists
Verify category breakdown (security, codeQuality, performance, dependency, architecture) exists
Document missing fields

tasks.title: Audit Issue Details Section
tasks.description: Verify individual issue data is complete. Check for id, ruleId, tool, file, line, column, message, description, severity, category, codeSnippet, hasFix, fixAvailable, fixConfidence, suggestedFix, status, blocksMerge, documentationUrl.
steps: Find issue array in V9 output
Pick 5 sample issues
Check each required field exists
Document missing fields per issue
Note if fields are inconsistent across issues

tasks.title: Audit Fix Details Section
tasks.description: Verify fix data is complete for showing diffs. Check for issueId, file, line, originalCode, fixedCode, diff, tier, tool, confidence, applied, verified, suggestion, steps.
steps: Find CategorizedFix[] or similar in V9 output
Verify originalCode and fixedCode fields exist
Check diff generation capability
Document missing fields

tasks.title: Audit Unfixed Issues Section
tasks.description: Verify manual guidance data exists. Check for issueId, reason, explanation, authorAction (type, description, steps, blocksMerge), reviewPriority, estimatedEffort, suggestedApproach, documentationLinks.
steps: Find UnfixedIssue[] or similar in V9 output
Verify guidance fields exist
Check authorAction has actionable steps
Document missing fields

tasks.title: Audit Educational Content Section
tasks.description: Verify learning resources data exists. Check for issueExplanations (title, whatItMeans, whyItMatters, howToFix, examples), recommendedResources, skillGaps.
steps: Search for educational content in V9 output
Check if rule explanations exist
Check if learning resources are generated
Document what AI enrichment provides vs what's static

tasks.title: Audit Gamification Section
tasks.description: Verify XP, levels, badges, skills data exists. Check for user (level, xp, xpToNextLevel, rank), prContribution (xpEarned, issuesFixed, newBadges, skillsImproved), badges array, skills array.
steps: Search for gamification data in V9 output
Check if XP calculation exists
Check if badge/achievement system outputs data
Check if skills tracking exists
Document what's missing

tasks.title: Audit Export Metadata Section
tasks.description: Verify data needed for SARIF/GitLab exports exists. Check for sarif structure, gitlabCodeQuality structure, analysisId, repositoryUrl, prNumber, baseBranch, prBranch, analyzedAt, duration.
steps: Check if SARIF export structure exists
Check if GitLab Code Quality format exists
Verify metadata fields
Document missing export data

tasks.title: Create Data Gap Report
tasks.description: Document all missing fields for UI development. Create docs/V9_DATA_GAP_REPORT.md with P0 (blocks UI), P1 (important), P2 (nice-to-have) categorization.
steps: Compile all missing fields from tasks 2-9
Categorize by priority (P0 = blocks UI, P1 = important, P2 = nice-to-have)
Create action items for filling gaps
Save report to docs/V9_DATA_GAP_REPORT.md

tasks.title: Run Oracle Cloud V9 E2E and Generate BASIC/PRO Reports
tasks.description: Run established V9 E2E script on Oracle Cloud against a real PR to generate BASIC and PRO tier reports for manual review. Uses packages/agents/scripts/testing/oracle/oracle-run-v9-e2e-complete.sh
steps: SSH to Oracle Cloud (129.213.49.128) and verify infrastructure is ready
Run the established oracle-run-v9-e2e-complete.sh script which executes test-v9-e2e-complete.ts
Wait for V9 analysis to complete on Apache Kafka repository (5-8 minutes expected)
Download generated BASIC tier report (analysis-only, all issues listed) from /tmp/v9-reports/
Run V9 with fix generation enabled (PRO tier) - includes three-tier fix cascade
Download generated PRO tier report (with fixes applied, fix summary, remaining issues)
Copy both reports to docs/sample-reports/ for user manual review
Create docs/sample-reports/README.md documenting which PR was analyzed and how to interpret reports
